name: Valheim
author: aetheris-project
description: Valheim dedicated server via SteamCMD with world management, public/community visibility and configurable player slots.

installation.script:
# @author Aetheris Project
# @description Valheim install script
# @user-alpine

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl

mkdir -p /home/container/steamcmd /home/container/.config/unity3d/IronGate/Valheim /home/container/logs
cd /home/container

curl -sSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update 896660 validate +quit

cat > start_server.sh <<EOF
#!/bin/bash
cd /home/container
./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update 896660 validate +quit
exec ./valheim_server.x86_64 "$@"
EOF
chmod +x start_server.sh

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Display name of the server in the community list.

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: Name of the world (seed and save folder).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players must enter to join.
